about: Official registry of every game in the feed. Numbers are permanent: never renumber or reuse one. 'planned' holds games that are designed but not built yet (their spec is in specs/). The feed app and LEDGER.md are generated from this file. A game is on the phone app only when its 'in_app' is true, and that is set only when Nabeel says to put it on the app; until then it is just a page for him to play-test. 'core': true marks the core games (the first six): they are inside the phone app itself and always on the phone. Every other game on the app is played over the internet, and he can save one from the Games list to keep it on the phone.

feed_app.name: Game Feed
feed_app.summary: All the games in one scrolling app: a shuffled feed of game cards (a short silent clip of each), tap to play at the level he was on, swipe for the next, search and pin; Pause on the bar, and Resume, Restart and Levels on every paused game. Built from this registry by tools/build_feed.py; the same build is the hosted page, the inside of the Android app, and the 'app-v2' branch that installed apps fetch new games from, so a phone gets every new game by itself. Changes to the feed page or the Android wrapper reach him only in a new GameFeed.apk. The core games (the first six) are inside the app and always on the phone; every other game is fetched when its card comes up, and Save in the Games list keeps one on the phone so it plays with no internet.
feed_app.published_frozen: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Nabeel1305/game-feed/app/ (build 18, read by the first installed apps; never push to it or delete it)

games.name: Bottle Cap Flick
games.summary: Flick bottle caps to knock the other side's caps off a wooden stool. Capture line, legs at each end, a ladder of four computer levels from Beginner to Legendary (beat one to open the next), best of 1/3/5/7.
games.source: games/bottle-cap-flick/src (engine.js + game.tpl.html -> build.py; train.js = self-play tests)

feed.hook: Flick your caps across the stool. Knock theirs off.

games.name: Knockout
games.summary: First-person two-thumb boxing. Tap to punch, flick to dodge, flick up for an uppercut, hold both to block. Endless levels, rounds and points decisions.

feed.hook: First-person boxing. Jab, slip, block, put him down.

principles: P8 camera kick + bruises that stay
P18 combo chain with rising notes
P12 KO celebration (flash bulbs, bell, slow-mo)
P17 rare cat on the apron

games.name: High Noon
games.summary: Cowboy quick-draw duel. Thumb on the holster, wait for DRAW (watch for fake calls), slide up to aim, release to shoot. Headshots win; endless levels.

feed.hook: Hand on the holster. Wait for the call, then draw.

principles: P7 freeze on the winning shot
P11 haptic tick on the count and DRAW

games.name: Steel & Honour
games.summary: First-person medieval sword duels. Your blade follows your finger in any direction; tap to poke an exact spot. His cuts come from any angle and his thrusts aim at a spot: block by swiping across his blade on the side it comes from (or through the spot of a thrust). Perfect parries open him up. Endless levels, rounds, champion knights, huge variety of knights.

feed.hook: Sword duels where the blade follows your finger.

principles: P18 parry chain with rising steel
P7 hit-stop on parries and the winning blow
P8 dents and scratches that stay

games.name: Zenith
games.summary: Superhero rescue patrols over Brightwater City. Alert after alert: fly through gold rings, then catch falling people, zap meteors with laser eyes, punch bad guys, blow out fires, lift hanging buses, and dodge-and-zap giant monsters and super villains. Missions are mixed from long lists so they rarely repeat.

feed.hook: One hero, a city of emergencies. Catch, zap, lift, fight.

principles: P18 rising chimes for rings and catches
P26 variety: never the same mission twice in a row
P13 best saves-in-a-row + lifetime citizens helped
P12 SAVED! stamp, bigger for monsters/villains

games.name: Hippodrome
games.summary: Greek four-horse chariot racing seen from behind your own chariot. Two thumbs: left steers the reins, right taps the whip on the beat of the gallop or holds to rein in. Turning the post is the skill: rein in, hug the inside, whip out, and pass rivals by turning tighter than they do. Ram a rival who is level with you by swerving into them, dodge when a rough rival winds up to ram you, and break a chariot to put it out of the race; damage shows on the chariot. Live leaderboard, 4 to 8 chariots with Greek names, 12 venues from Olympia to Troy, a champion of legend every 10th race, endless levels.

feed.hook: Four horses, one wreath. Whip on the beat, ram your rivals.

principles: P18 chains: perfect whip cracks climb in pitch; perfect turns chain
P4 readable failure: painted braking zone, slide dust and lean, WHEEL UP warning, flashing wind bar, a clear warning before every ram
P3 honest near-miss: real finishing gaps, real turn times, real clearance from the post, the true cost of every blow
P12 celebrations scaled: overtake call, perfect turn, a rival broken, the wreath
P13 personal bests: race time and best lap per level, longest whip chain

games.name: Bandit
games.summary: A one-on-one fighter-jet dogfight above the clouds, seen from just behind your own jet. Two thumbs: the left flies (push it where the nose should go; hard turns cost speed), the right fires and drops flares. Get behind the bandit and hold him in your ring to lock on, then fire a missile; up close, hold FIRE for the cannon. He weaves, drops flares, then hauls round and comes for you: a mirror shows him on your tail, and when his missile is in the air you turn hard and tap FLARE as the ring closes on the button. Bandits with their own call signs, jets and paint, an ace every 10th sortie, one to three bandits a sortie, stars for taking no hits, endless levels.

feed.hook: One bandit on your tail. Break, flare, turn the tables.

principles: P4 readable failure: lock warning with a mirror and a bar, MISSILE! call, the ring that closes on FLARE, and TOO EARLY / TOO LATE / TURN HARDER after a wasted flare
P5 teach by doing: sortie 1 he only flies, sortie 2 he starts behind you for the flare lesson, sortie 3 he flares; one coach line at a time
P7 hit-stop and slow motion on a kill; P8 shake and smoke that stays on a damaged jet
P3 honest near-miss: on a loss, how much of his jet was left and what your last flare did wrong
P13 personal bests: fastest sortie per level, longest run of sorties won
P2 disclosed help after three losses: he locks slower and his missiles fly slower; the rules stay the same

games.name: Plunder
games.summary: A pirate game in two halves. You set sail on an expedition and steer your sloop from above until the lookout sights a ship or a fleet of up to three, merchant, navy or both: the card shows the loot and the danger, and you raid or sail on. Navy ships must be beaten with cannons first: their guns only reach out of their sides (shown in red before they fire); yours fire from the wheel when a ship is in your gold arc (going round and round hard over spoils the aim), ROW gives a short burst of speed until the crew tire, and a quick sloop can sit on a heavy ship's bow or stern. Then you come alongside and board (the first three boardings teach every move, slowly, and the fight starts only once you can do each one two or three times): first person, on deck, below deck and in the captain's cabin. Block his blow with one swipe across his blade, on the side it comes from, and strike while he is open; or attack first, hammering his sword until his guard breaks (but just after, he is set, and a blow then is turned and punished); pull down to dodge; one pistol ball at a time, slow to reload, three in all, and you drag the sights onto him. One bar is the tide of the fight: fight well and your crew takes the ship, fight badly and they break. Spamming cannot win, at sea or on deck, on any expedition: no repeated pattern of moves does, at any speed. The win screen counts out the loot. Calm shanty while cruising, fast with a drum once a sail is sighted. Expeditions get harder for ever; a treasure fleet every 10th; stars, best haul and pirate rank.

feed.hook: Sight a sail. Beat her guns. Board her and take the gold.

principles: P4 fair readable failure: her gun ports open and the red fan fills before she fires; every blow shows its path (white, then gold when a block will count); after a wound it says why (TOO EARLY, MISSED THE BLOCK, CAUGHT SWINGING)
P7 hit-stop: a heartbeat of stillness on a clean block, a riposte, the pistol, a broadside striking home
P12 celebration scaled: a man down, a deck taken, the captain yielding, then the loot counted out line by line with rising coins
P14 goal-gradient: one bar for the tide of the fight, three parts of the ship, four pips for the expedition
P18 chains: clean blocks in a row ring higher and sharpen the riposte; best run is kept

games.name: Reel

feed.hook: Wait for the float to go under. Then hold on.

games.summary: A fishing game in 3D, seen from the end of a wooden jetty on a mountain lake, with the weather and light changing by level (dawn, rain, mist, storm, sunset, night with a glowing float). Pull your thumb down and let go to cast to where fish are rising; leave the little nibbles and flick up to strike when the float is pulled right under (too soon scares them, too late loses the bait). Then fight it home: hold to reel, let go when it thrashes and runs or the line snaps, and drag against its way to turn it from the reeds and lily pads. Land the fish asked for before the light goes; three lines. The first three levels teach every move. Six kinds of fish plus rare golden carp and a named giant every tenth level; your biggest of each kind is kept.

games.name: Wild Water

feed.hook: Two thumbs, two paddles. Find the line through the rocks.

games.summary: A whitewater kayak game in 3D, seen from the cockpit with the bow in front and the paddle in your gloves. Your two thumbs are the two blades: swipe down on the left for a left stroke (it swings the bow right), on the right for a right stroke; swipe up to back-paddle. The current carries you down a winding river through rows of rocks with one gap each, past fallen trees on the outside of the bends, over ledges you must take straight through the smooth tongue, and between slalom gates for stars. Three smashes or rolls and the boat is done. Weather and light change by run. The first three runs teach every stroke.

games.name: Soar

feed.hook: Fly over the sea and the mountains, through the golden rings.

games.summary: The calm one: a 3D flight over a sea of islands, seen from just over your shoulder, arms forward and a scarf streaming, under a real sky that changes by flight (golden hour, dawn, mist, sunset, night with stars). One thumb steers like a little stick wherever you put it down: right to lean and turn, up to climb, down to dive. Follow a trail of golden rings; each ring is a bell note that climbs the scale while the chain lasts. Nothing hurts you: touch the sea or a hillside and you skim off it. Fly through enough rings to finish the flight; all of them for three stars.

games.name: Vine

feed.hook: Let go at the top of the swing. Catch the next vine.

games.summary: Swing through a 3D rainforest gorge on vines, a river far below, light falling through mist, weather by canopy. Your thumb is your grip: keep it down to hold the vine and swing, lift it to let go as you swing forward and up (each vine needs its own moment), lean in the air by moving the thumb, and put it down to catch the next vine when your hand reaches it. Grab at air and the hand needs a moment; fall and you are back on the last vine, one of three lives. Reach the tree house before the light goes. The first three canopies teach every move.

games.name: Hunter

feed.hook: Creep through the grass. Freeze when it looks. Then throw.

games.summary: The intense one: an ice-age hunt in 3D, first person, crouched in tall grass on a steppe under snowy mountains, weather by hunt. Left thumb held creeps forward; lift it to freeze when the animal flicks its ears and looks up, or it sees you and bolts. Right thumb pulls back and lets go to throw a flint spear where the mark on the ground is: the chest brings it down, a haunch only wounds it, and far throws fall short. Sometimes a cave lion growls from one side: swipe toward it and tap the instant it leaps to brace your spear. Deer, horses, boar, bison, and a woolly mammoth every tenth hunt. A heartbeat that quickens as you close in.

games.name: Police Chase

feed.hook: Lights on. Ram him off the road, then run him down.

games.summary: A three-part police chase in 3D through a city at night. Pursuit: hold the left or right side of the screen to steer your patrol car (both to brake) through traffic, and ram the getaway car's back corner from the side to spin him out. On foot: chase him down a brick alley, swiping round crates, over fences and under pipes, and tap to tackle when you are right behind him. Arrest: when he twists one way, swipe the other way to hold him until the cuffs are on. Lights, siren, rain on the tarmac; weather changes by case.

games.name: Pilot

feed.hook: Bring her down gently. Flare at the last moment.

games.summary: Land an airliner in 3D at a countryside airport, seen from just behind the plane, in weather that changes by flight (fog, rain, storm, sunset, night with the runway lights). Right thumb is the control column: left and right to bank, pull back to raise the nose; left thumb is the throttle. Follow the glide-path lights (two white, two red), keep on the centre line in a crosswind, hold the speed, then flare just before the wheels touch for a soft landing. The first three flights teach it a piece at a time.

games.name: Short Order

feed.hook: Golden, not burnt. Get the orders out.

games.summary: Run the grill of a small 3D diner kitchen, seen from where the cook stands, with the street's weather and light in the window. Drag food from the trays onto the pans, the board or the plate; tap a pan to flip when the ring turns golden; sweep across the board to chop; drag the plate up to the pass. Pancakes, eggs on toast, burgers, salmon salad, steak and onions: golden, not burnt, before the customer walks out. The first three levels teach it a piece at a time.

games.name: Country Vet

feed.hook: Calm them, find what hurts, make it better.

games.summary: Be the vet in an old 3D barn, the farmyard's weather and light through the open door. Dogs, cows, sheep, horses, pigs and goats come in with a thorn, an overgrown hoof, a cut, a fever, caked mud or a sore ear. Read the owner's card, look at her to see where, pick the right tool and use it the way it is really used: pull a thorn out slowly, rasp a hoof to the line, spray and wrap a cut, hold the needle in and lift off when she shivers, brush with the hair, drop into a still ear. Rough handling frightens her: stroke her slowly to calm her. The first three levels teach every tool.

games.name: Lighthouse

feed.hook: Light the way home. Lead each lost boat past the rocks.

games.summary: Keep a lighthouse on a wild night, in 3D, from the gallery at the top: a dark moving sea, rain and lightning or stars and a moon. Lost fishing boats drift towards the rocks. Your thumb is the lamp: hold the beam on a boat until its lamp blinks back, then lead it slowly, round rocks that only show in your light, to the harbour's red and green lights. Several boats can follow the one light. The first three levels teach it.

games.name: Hiring

feed.hook: Read the CV. Find the job it fits. Or the bin.

games.summary: Run the hiring desk of a busy town agency, flat 2D on a wooden desk so the papers read well. Three open jobs are pinned at the top with what each needs; CVs come one at a time (photo, age, where they live, experience, certificates with their dates, licence and points, languages, when they can work). Drag each onto the job it fits, or into the bin. Near misses grow: a year short, a certificate that ran out last month. Two wrong calls end the day. The first three levels teach it.

games.name: Potter's Wheel

feed.hook: Shape the spinning clay to match the order.

games.summary: Throw pots on a wheel in a 3D workshop, the yard's weather and light in the window and your fired pots on the shelves. A lump of wet clay spins; the order's outline is dotted on both sides. Touch the side of the clay and move slowly: it follows your fingertip in or out. Too quick and it wobbles and can collapse. Tap FIRE when the match passes the mark. Later the clay dries. The first three levels teach it.

games.name: Drone Pilot

feed.hook: Two sticks, like a real drone. Thread every hoop.

games.summary: Fly a racing drone through a course of glowing hoops in a 3D park (hills, trees, buildings, weather and wind by level), seen from just behind. Two sticks, like a real controller: left thumb climbs and turns, right thumb flies forwards and slides. The drone drifts and the wind pushes it; each hoop gives back seconds; clip a rim or a tree and it crashes. The first three levels teach it.

games.name: Whaling

feed.hook: Row to the spout. Throw. Then hold on.

games.summary: Hunt whales the old way from a wooden whaleboat on a grey 3D sea. Left thumb steers while the crew rows to her spout; swipe up with the right thumb to throw the harpoon while her back is up (lead her). Then hold on: hold to haul the line and tire her, let go when her flukes rise before a run or the line snaps, keep the bow pointing at her or the boat heels over. The first three levels teach it.

games.name: Wolf Pack

feed.hook: Run it down with your pack. Strike from the side.

games.summary: Run as the lead wolf of a small pack across open 3D snow between dark pines (golden dusk, grey morning, falling snow, night). One elk in the fleeing herd is marked. Slide your thumb to steer, push it up for a burst (it tires you), tap FLANK to send a packmate up one side so she swerves towards you, and flick towards her to strike when you are close and beside her; from straight behind she kicks. Reach her before the trees. The first three levels teach it.

games.name: On the Run

feed.hook: Swipe to dodge, tap for nitro. Get to the safehouse.

games.summary: Getaway in three phases: weave the night avenue, dodge rams and roadblocks with swipes and nitro, then run the alleys on foot to the safehouse; a garage of upgrades and a rank that stay.

games.name: Castle Siege

feed.hook: Build towers, upgrade them, hold the gate.

games.summary: Tower defence in a 3D valley, all taps: build archers, catapults, mages and frost by the road, upgrade them, drop meteors; eight roads, ten kinds of foe and a boss every tenth siege; royal upgrades and rank that stay.

games.name: Tag

feed.hook: Chase, flee, freeze: the playground's fastest kid.

games.summary: Playground tag in 3D with a floating stick and a double-tap dash: chase, run, freeze tag, zombie tag and the big kid, with power-ups, places, a tuck shop of upgrades and a rank that stay.

games.name: Heaven or Hell

feed.hook: Weigh their deeds. Up to Heaven, down to Hell.

games.summary: Keep the gate: weigh each soul's best and worst deed, unseal hidden deeds in the Book of Life, mind the day's rule and the liars, and drag them up, down or to Purgatory; blessings and rank that stay.

games.name: Harvest Valley

feed.hook: Plant, water, harvest: fill the orders by sunset.

games.summary: A farm by the day in 3D, all taps: plant, water when a crop asks, pick when it sparkles, collect eggs, shoo crows and fill the cart's orders by sunset; seasons and rain; farm upgrades and rank that stay.

games.name: Horde

feed.hook: Monsters from every side. Move, level up, survive.

games.summary: Survive the night horde with one thumb: weapons fire by themselves, you pick an upgrade at every level-up, light three beacons to call the boss and beat it.

games.name: Mini Golf

feed.hook: Pull back, let go. Windmills, ramps and water.

games.summary: Calm 3D mini golf: pull back and let go to putt around windmills, bumpers, slopes and water, under par to win, with a shop and ranks.

games.name: Penalty Kings

feed.hook: Pick your corner. Read the kicker. Win the cup.

games.summary: A cup run of penalty shootouts in a floodlit stadium: tap where to shoot and stop the needle in the green; read the kicker's body when he plants his foot and dive the right way.

games.name: Critter Clash

feed.hook: Fire beats leaf. Time your hit. Catch them all.

games.summary: Turn-by-turn battles between teams of bouncing critters: fire beats leaf, time the ring for a critical, guard the big attacks, and catch wild critters for your collection.

games.name: Rodeo

feed.hook: Eight seconds. One angry bull. Lean against every buck.

games.summary: Eight seconds on a bucking bull with two thumbs: hold left or right to lean, read his head to lean against each buck before it lands, grip the spins, and score with the judges.

games.name: Eleven

feed.hook: Turn your phone sideways. Eleven a side. Beat every team.

games.summary: A full eleven-a-side football match played sideways: run with the left thumb, PASS, SHOOT and LOB; beat a team and the next one is better.

games.name: Deep Bite

feed.hook: Eat the small ones. Flee the big ones. Grow.

games.summary: His shark idea in 3D: drag to swim, eat the fish smaller than you, run from the hunters, grow until what chased you becomes lunch; a golden fish beside a hunter, an aquarium of every kind you find.

games.name: Powder

feed.hook: Carve the mountain. Beat your own ghost.

games.summary: Snowboard down a 3D mountain against the clock: hold and slide to carve through the gates, tap to jump rocks, spin off kickers and land straight; your best run rides beside you as a ghost; boards to open.

games.name: Cairn

feed.hook: Stack river stones by the lake. How high can it stand?

games.summary: The calm one: stack river stones on a boulder by a misty 3D lake; tap to drop the swaying stone, pick slabs or round stones from the basket, three perfect drops find a stone; your finished cairns stay in the shallows.

games.name: Pinball

feed.hook: Two thumbs, two flippers. Light the whole table.

games.summary: A real 3D pinball table: hold the left or right half for each flipper, catch and aim, finish the missions on the backbox (the ramp, the drop targets, the orbit) before the balls are gone; multiplier, extra ball, multiball, trophies.

games.name: Drumline

feed.hook: Two drums, one beat. Keep the crowd on its feet.

games.summary: A rhythm game in a 3D stadium at halftime: notes roll down two lanes to a snare and a tom, tap left and right on the beat, gold notes for both, drum rolls; the crowd meter, FEVER, a new song every level.
